rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose direct term for weeping with short, convulsive gasps.

example.english: They began to sob in the corner, and no one paid attention.
example.traditional: 佢喺角落度開始抽泣，冇人理佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 gok3 lok6 dou6 hoi1 ci2 cau1 jap1 mou5 jan4 lei5 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when someone says words while crying, especially before a quoted remark.

example.english: They sob, “I don’t want to go home!”
example.traditional: 佢喊住話：「我唔想返屋企呀！」
example.jyutping: keoi5 haam3 zyu6 waa6 ngo5 m4 soeng2 faan1 uk1 kei2 aa3
